name: Apalachicola
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Apalachicola?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Plain golf carts only on streets the city designates, and that list was not found. Apalachicola charges a golf cart registration fee. This map does not turn a street green for a golf cart without the street list. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
The city fee schedule charges a golf cart registration under an ordinance

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Apalachicola?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Apalachicola?
faq.a: Only on a street the city has designated and signed. That list was not found, so this map does not show those streets as golf cart roads.
